videos.title: What a Medium Learned About Death in 40 Years | John Edward
videos.description:
In this clip, John Edward and Jay Shetty talk about the reading he walked into at 15 to debunk, and the one question that stopped Jay's producer cold: "Who's Chris?"

John breaks down what he sees, hears and feels in a session, why he asks people not to say a word for the first 10 minutes, and the red flags that tell you someone's taking advantage of your grief.

Learn about why nobody dies alone, what happens in a room the moment a pet comes through, and the morning after his mom passed when he realized nobody would ever care what time he came home.
